tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Lists the products, sizes, finishes and quantities in the Print Pronto US Sticker & Label Price Index (November 2026). Takes no input. Read-only.

tools.name: get_price_range
tools.description: Looks up one job in the Print Pronto US Sticker & Label Price Index (US dollars, whole job): lowest listed, typical, fair range and highest listed price. If the exact job is not in the index it says so and returns the nearest jobs for the same product. It never estimates. Use list_products first to

tools.description: Compares a quote (US dollars, whole job) with the Print Pronto US Sticker & Label Price Index for the same job.
